35392: A nearly sightless boy is sent to a school for blind children, where he secretly discovers the possibilities of the recorded sound.
35648: Ramakrishna aka Ricky's only one goal in life is to be a RAW recruitee and undertake some Planet-saving mission. Ricky must tame The God, the megalomaniacal lynchpin of a giant-sized crime syndicate.
RAW Chief Colonel Mahadev Menon 'The Devil'
35904: A crazed scientist experimenting with a rage virus on innocent victims in a laboratory in the woods. When his monstrous subjects escape and vultures devour their remains, they became mutations seeking to feed on humans.
36160: In the Philadelphia police department, Emmett Young is a hotshot, a workaholic newly promoted to homicide. He's out now... The terror has just begun!

Monsters in a land that time forgot!

Tonight they will rise from the darkness beneath the city... to feed!

There Are Some Things In The Universe That We Can't Understand

Something Extraordinary Is About To Happen

The only way out is to face her own fears.
39488: A group of friends attempts to make a 'halal' film that conforms to the guidelines and descriptions of an Islamic organization which they are a part of.
Azad. Sound Recordist in Tele Cinema

Three Men. Two destinations. One choice.

They lost their way...but found a magical adventure!

Being the new kid in class is never easy.

Raised in the streets, trained by an assassin.

A Maximum Security Prison - Thousands of Infected Inmates - Only One Way Out!

Getting out is the deadly part.

Will Justice Win Out Over Evil? Will Courage Overcome Corruption?

M. Roland, le patron de l'épicerie
Le caissier de la loterie « Les Geules cassées »
Émile, le garçon épicier et un invité à la noce

Here comes...the HAPPIEST SHOW ON EARTH!

49472: A girl from bourgeoisie discovers the pleasures of banditism, following her lover in his lifestyle.

MGM's drama of the fighting French!

Now disguised as Private Julius Rasmussen, Erna heads for the front. In her encounters with the other soldiers and in the presence of the war, unknown sides of Erna are awoken. The world is at war but one woman is fighting her own

If we change the beginning of the story, we change the whole story.

Between dreams & nightmares... between reality & fantasy... lies the terror of

I Don't Wanna' Live Any More... How 'Bout You?
